name: LVMH Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton SE

thesisState.summary: Deep Dive completed. Thesis work should focus on whether Fashion & Leather Goods can normalize growth/margins after the current luxury slowdown, with Sephora/Jewelry offset, China/US demand, FX and FCF quality as key variables.
whatWouldChangeOurMind: Sustained deterioration in Fashion & Leather Goods organic growth or margin beyond cyclical slowdown.
Evidence that China/US luxury demand weakness is structural rather than cyclical.
Material deterioration in cash conversion, leverage or brand pricing power.
thesisState.portfolioManagerDecision: in portfolio; valuation/model step pending if user wants deeper work

keyDrivers: Fashion & Leather Goods organic growth recovery
Louis Vuitton/Dior brand desirability and pricing power
Sephora and Jewelry offset to luxury soft patch
China/Asia and US luxury demand normalization
Lease-adjusted FCF quality and capital allocation
keyRisks: China weakness lasting longer than expected
Margin compression from mix, opex or under-absorption
watchMetrics: Fashion & Leather Goods organic revenue growth
China/Asia ex-Japan and US revenue trends
Wines & Spirits organic growth and inventory commentary
Net debt / liquidity and buyback cadence
openQuestions: What normalized F&LG growth/margin should be used after the luxury slowdown?
How much of current weakness is cyclical vs brand-specific?
What valuation multiple is justified versus Hermes/Kering/Richemont under slower growth?
How resilient is FCF after leases, capex and working capital normalization?
